{
  "score": 7,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "tests/integration/resume-rehydrate-test.sh",
      "category": "coverage",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 851,
      "message": "The `stage.skip` assertions at lines 851–855 (DSFRSH-1) and 983–988 (DSFRSH-2) are vacuously true: `stage.skip` is registered in `config/event-schema.json` but is never emitted by any `.sh` file in the codebase, so asserting its count is zero can never fail regardless of whether a fresh run erroneously skips stages via any other mechanism.",
      "quote": "    _s12_stage_skips=\"$(jq -r 'select(.type==\"stage.skip\") | .type' \\\n        \"$S12_EVENTS_JSONL\" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 1477,
      "message": "Within the first resumed iteration (`_resume_first_iter=true`), cycle members already marked complete are skipped with `continue` at line 1490 without verifying that their primary artifact is present after rehydration; DSRHYD-2 requires exit 1 before any `stage.start` when a complete stage's artifact is absent, but this check is absent for intra-iteration cycle members — the outer dispatch-unit cycle:* check in runner.sh only fires when the entire cycle is marked complete, leaving partially-complete iterations unguarded.",
      "quote": "            if [[ \"$_cmbr_status\" == \"complete\" ]]; then\n                # Add persisted verdict/status to blob so exit_when/abort_when/until\n                # predicates that reference this member can evaluate correctly.\n                local _cmbr_verdict",
      "introduced": false,
      "fix": "code"
    }
  ]
}
